about.title: About
about.summary: Personal engineering account for self-hosted infrastructure, embedded firmware, and local AI. I build 24/7 server daemons and telemetry APIs, ESP32 and SDR sensor nodes, personal cloud storage, and on-device LLM tooling — end-to-end systems that run a homelab from bare metal to dashboard.
about.mscDetails: Research Areas: Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning applied to RF, Computational Structures, and Optimization
about.bscDetails2: Focus Areas: Digital Signal Processing (DSP), Software Defined Radio (SDR), Hardware Design, and IoT Systems
about.accountsIntro: Two accounts, two contexts — the same engineer behind both.
about.accountsMochaDesc: Personal and client work: homelab infrastructure, embedded systems, self-hosted services, and product builds.
about.accountsEduDesc: Academic and scientific work at the National University of Colombia: RF, DSP, SDR, and machine-learning research.

experience.title: Experience
experience.gcpdsHighlight1: C/Python firmware development for an IoT spectral monitoring sensor based on HackRF SDR on Raspberry Pi 5, with hybrid architecture (C for real-time IQ acquisition, Python for orchestration), autonomous PPM calibration, and WebRTC streaming
experience.gcpdsHighlight2: Backend platform implementation with REST API (FastAPI), TimescaleDB time-series database, and real-time spectral visualization dashboard
experience.gcpdsHighlight3: Mobile application development for deployment and validation of Image Segmentation models
experience.teachingHighlight1: Academic teaching assistant for Signals and Systems and Machine Learning Theory, advising groups of 30+ students
experience.teachingHighlight2: Design and instruction of hands-on Python workshops for signal analysis and processing, integrating NumPy, SciPy, and Matplotlib
